rows.note: Use 房間 as the all-purpose term for a separate enclosed room in a building.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 fong4 gaan1 mou5 coeng1

rows.note: Use 空間 for available space or scope to do something rather than for a physical room.

example.english: There is no room here to put a table.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 mou5 hung1 gaan1 baai2 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use 房 for someone’s bedroom or for an individual rented room serving as their lodging.

example.english: My room is on the third floor.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaan1 fong4 hai2 saam1 lau4

rows.note: Use 聊天室 for an online chat room.

example.english: We chatted in the chat room all night.
example.traditional: 我哋喺聊天室傾咗成晚偈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 liu4 tin1 sat1 king1 zo2 seng4 maan5 gai2
